reasoning_content: Only keycloak.jar exists in /opt/keycloak/lib/app — and grep didn't find messages_de.properties (exit code 1 = not found). Keycloak 26 packages its themes in a different way. Let's look for where the messages are: maybe they're inside /opt/keycloak/lib/quarkus/lib/*.jar. Let's search more broadly.

action.command:
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 -c '
ls /opt/keycloak/lib/quarkus/lib/ | head -20
for j in /opt/keycloak/lib/quarkus/lib/keycloak-*.jar; do
  unzip -l "$j" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "base/messages/messages_de.properties" && echo "FOUND $j"
done
echo DONE' 2>&1 | tail -8
